paite: Kumpipa Uzzia a sih kumin TOUPA laltutphah sang tak tawisana tu ka mu a, a puansilh mong tualin baikin a dimsak vek hi.
english: In the year that king Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

paite: A kiangah serafte a ding ua; kha guk chiat a nei ua, a kha nihte un a mai uh a khuh ua, nihin a khepekte uh a khuh ua, nihin a leng uhi.
english: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

paite: Huan, Sepaihte TOUPA a siangthou hi, a siangthou hi, a siangthou hi, lei pumpi a thupinain a dim, chiin, a kikou tuahsek uhi.
english: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”

paite: Huchiin a kikou husain kongpi bul suangphum nasanin a ling sak dudupa, in tuh meikhuin a dimta hi.
english: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

paite: Huaitakin, ken, Muk nin pu mi ka hi-a, muk nin pu mite laka om ka hih jiakin ka tung gik hina tele! mangthang ka hita ve; ka mitin lah kumpipa, sepaihte TOUPA, a muta ngala, ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”

paite: Huchiin, seraf khat, maitam akipan taiteha teh, meiam tawiin ka kiangah a hong lenga, ka kam honbi a,
english: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

paite: Ngaiin, thulimlouhna lakmang a hita, na khelhna leng sawpsiang a hita, a chi a.
english: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

paite: Huan, kua ka sawl dia, kou-a dia kua kuan ding ahia? chiin, TOUPA aw ka ja,
english: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”

paite: Huchiin, ken, kei hiaiah ka om, honsawl ve, ka chi a. Huan, a man, Kuan inla, hiai mite va hilhin, Bilin a jak jaw ja unla, theihsiam bel theihsiam kei un; muh jaw mu unla, theih bel theikei un, chiin.
english: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand; and you see indeed, but don’t perceive.’

paite: Hiai chite lungtang thausak inla, a na uh ngongsak inla, a mitte uh mitsi sakin; huchilouinjaw a mit un a mu ding ua, a bil un a za ding ua, a lungtang un leng a thei ding ua, a hongkihei nawn ding uhi, a chi a.
english: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”

paite: Huan, ken, TOUPA bangtan ahi dia? ka chi a. Huan, aman, hondawnga. Khopite a teng ding beia suksiata a oma, inte a mi beia a oma, gam hoih sipsipa a om,
english: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, and houses without man, and the land becomes utterly waste,

paite: TOUPAN mite gamla pi-a a suana, gamsunga mun paisansa tampi a om masiah.Huan, a sungah sawm lakah khat leng omlai om leh nek khitin a om behlap ding uhi: ahihhangin nahhi let tosaw phukkhit nunga a bul a om nilouh bangin chi siangthou a bul om nilouhlouh ahi, kachi.
english: And Yahweh has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many in the midst of the land.

paite: Huan, a sungah sawm lakah khat leng omlai om leh nek khitin a om behlap ding uhi: ahihhangin nahhi let tosaw phukkhit nunga a bul a om nilouh bangin chi siangthou a bul om nilouhlouh ahi, kachi.
english: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed: as a terebinth, and as an oak, whose stock remains when they are felled; so the holy seed is its stock.”
